name: transition-card-flip
title: 3D Card Flip
description: Cảnh cũ xoay quanh trục dọc tới 90°, đổi mặt, cảnh mới xoay tiếp từ −90° về phẳng như lật một tấm thẻ.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Outgoing scene rotateY 0 -> 90 deg (perspective origin on the hinge, slight 0.9 scale during the turn), at 300 ms hide it and show the incoming from -90 -> 0 deg; 600 ms easeInOutCubic overall; never show a back face (fold to 90 and swap). HF showcase-3d ships a Card Flip (Apache-2.0). Params: duration (0.6 s) · perspective · scale lúc lật (0.9).
